Consider the rank 4 free group Г = (a,b,c, d). Let T be the free splitting obtained from U by collapsing all edges labelled a, b, c, d, so T has a single natural edge orbit, represented by the T-image of any e-edge of U. Let a C T be the image of ã. Note that a crosses the unique natural edge orbit three times, the middle crossing being an interior crossing. Again a is contained in the axis of C in T, and a consists of one entire fundamental domain of that axis followed by the first edge of the next fundamental domain. Note that no two distinct translates of the axis of C have a common edge in T. It follows that the protocomponent Bfa (a) equals the axis of C' in T, and that C = Stab(Pia (a)). But C has trivial image under abelianization of (a, b, c, d) and hence C' is not a free factor of (a, b, c, d). In fact we have the equation Fa;T] = {[a, b, c, d)]}, in other words C fills the group (a, b, c, d), and hence a fills T by Proposition 2.9.
